data.name: Exquisite Agony
data.description: When a member of your collective dies, instead of needing to make a save to avoid taking damage, you gain a number of temporary power points equal to the Hit Die of the creature killed.  These power points last %1 rounds and do not stack with each other or other temporary power points.|ExquisiteAgonyDuration
